texto:
Organic food is food that is produced without using chemicals.
People buy organic food because they think it is healthy. But is it healthy for the planet?
Most people think that organic food is grown by small local farmers. But today, giant food companies like Coca Cola also grow organic food. Many of these big companies still use conventional farming methods that are very bad for the environment, even if the food they grow is more "healthy."

Another problem is that a lot of organic food actually comes from faraway countries. Gases from the trucks and airplanes that we use to transport our groceries across continents and countries are a major cause of global warming.
What can you do if you want to buy organic food, but you also want to help the environment?
One solution is to support your local farmer and encourage him to grow organic food. You can also join a community agriculture program. Members help pay for seeds, fertilizer, water, equipment, etc., and in return, the farm provides a healthy supply of fresh food.
So the answer is to buy organic, but also buy local!

opciones: Because they think it is healthy.
preguntas_opcion_multiple.correcta: Because they think it is healthy.

opciones: Buy organic food from faraway countries.

preguntas_vf.pregunta: Organic food always comes from small local farmers.

titulo: A Green Box: Is It Organic?
texto:
Emma is at the supermarket with her dad. She wants some cereal for breakfast.

“Look! This box is green. It has a tree and the words “100% natural.” Is it organic?” she asks.

“Let’s read the label,” says Dad. “A picture of a tree does not mean the food is organic.”

They look at another box. It has a small circle with the words “USDA Organic.”

“This is an official seal in the United States,” Dad explains. “Farmers and food companies must follow special rules to use it.”

“Does it mean all the ingredients are organic?” asks Emma.

“Not always. For cereal with this seal, at least 95% of the ingredients must be organic. Water and salt do not count.”

Emma looks at the two boxes again.

“So, a green box and a nice picture are not enough!”

“That’s right. Read the words, too.”

Before they buy the cereal, Emma checks one more thing: the price!

titulo: How to Pack an Emergency Backpack
texto: How to Pack an Emergency Backpack An emergency backpack can help you stay safe during an earthquake, a storm, or another emergency. First, find a strong backpack. Next, put three bottles of water inside. Then, add some food that does not need a refrigerator, such as crackers or canned food. After that, pack a flashlight and extra batteries. Next, add a first-aid kit with bandages and basic medicine. Then, put important documents in a waterproof bag. After that, add a cell phone charger, a whistle, and a change of clothes. Finally, keep the backpack in an easy-to-find place and check it every six months. Vocabulary emergency backpack flashlight batteries first-aid kit whistle waterproof document check

titulo: How to Stay Safe During an Earthquake
texto: How to Stay Safe During an Earthquake Earthquakes can happen without warning. It is important to know what to do before, during, and after an earthquake. First, stay calm. Do not run or panic. Next, get under a strong table or desk. If there is no table, sit next to an inside wall and protect your head and neck with your arms. Then, stay away from windows, mirrors, and tall furniture. These objects can break or fall. After that, wait until the shaking stops. Do not use elevators during an earthquake. Next, check yourself and other people for injuries. Help others if you can. Then, listen to the radio or check official information on your phone for emergency updates. After that, if the building is damaged, leave carefully and go to an open area away from buildings, trees, and power lines. Finally, stay with your family or friends and follow the instructions of emergency workers. Vocabulary earthquake warning strong injury damaged power line

texto: Marjane Satrapi's Rights and Responsibilities Marjane Satrapi grew up in Iran during a time of major political change. When she was a child, new laws affected many people's daily lives. Marjane wanted to understand what was happening in her country and often asked questions about politics and society. As a student, Marjane had the right to receive an education. She could learn about different subjects and discuss ideas with her family. However, life was not always easy. After the Revolution, girls had to wear a veil at school. Students had to follow new school rules, even if they did not always agree with them. Marjane's parents believed that children should think independently. At home, she could express her opinions and ask difficult questions. She may not have understood every political event, but she was encouraged to learn and think critically. Marjane also had responsibilities. She had to study, respect her teachers, and follow school policies. Her parents had to protect her and help her understand the changes taking place in Iran. As she grew older, Marjane learned that people can have rights and responsibilities at the same time. Citizens can express their beliefs, but they also have to respect others. Her experiences taught her that understanding history and society is an important responsibility for everyone. Vocabulary political change right veil independently policy citizen

texto: Hawaii vs. Puerto Rico Which Island Destination Is Better? Many people dream about visiting tropical islands. Two popular destinations are Hawaii and Puerto Rico. Both places have beautiful beaches, warm weather, and interesting cultures, but they are different in several ways. Hawaii is larger than Puerto Rico and has more famous volcanoes. It is also farther from Guatemala. Puerto Rico is closer to Guatemala, so flights are often shorter. Puerto Rico is generally more Spanish-speaking than Hawaii. For many Guatemalans, Puerto Rico may feel more familiar because Spanish is the main language. In contrast, English is more common in Hawaii. When it comes to nature, Hawaii has some of the most spectacular landscapes in the world. Its volcanoes are more impressive than those of many other destinations. Puerto Rico, however, has one of the most beautiful rainforests in the Caribbean, El Yunque. Both destinations have excellent beaches. Some travelers think Hawaii has the best surfing beaches, while others prefer Puerto Rico because it is less expensive than Hawaii. In general, Hawaii is one of the most expensive vacation destinations in the United States. Food is another interesting difference. Puerto Rican food is spicier than Hawaiian food in some cases, while Hawaiian cuisine is more influenced by Asian cultures. In the end, neither destination is clearly better than the other. Hawaii may be the most exciting choice for travelers who love volcanoes and surfing. Puerto Rico may be the most convenient option for people who want a Caribbean experience in a Spanish-speaking environment.

titulo: Digital Credit Cards vs. Physical Credit Cards
texto: Digital Credit Cards vs. Physical Credit Cards Many people use credit cards to pay for products and services. Today, customers can choose between digital credit cards and physical credit cards. Both options are convenient, but they have important differences. A digital credit card is stored on a smartphone or smartwatch. A physical credit card is a plastic card that people carry in their wallets. Digital credit cards are generally more convenient than physical credit cards because people usually carry their phones everywhere. They are also faster than physical cards in many stores because customers can simply tap their devices. On the other hand, physical credit cards are more widely accepted than digital cards in some places. Not every business accepts digital payments. Physical cards are also easier to use than digital cards for people who are not comfortable with technology. In terms of security, many experts believe that digital credit cards are safer than physical cards because they often use biometric verification such as fingerprints or facial recognition. If a wallet is stolen, a thief may use a physical card more easily. However, if a phone is lost, users can often lock it remotely. Digital cards are also more environmentally friendly than physical cards because they do not require plastic. Physical cards, however, may be the most practical option when a phone battery is dead. For frequent travelers, digital wallets are often the most convenient payment method because they allow people to carry several cards on one device. However, many consumers still believe that physical cards are the most reliable option in emergencies. In conclusion, neither option is perfect. Digital credit cards are generally faster, safer, and more convenient, while physical credit cards are often more practical and more widely accepted. The best choice depends on the user's needs.

titulo: Backstreet Boys vs. NSYNC: Which Boy Band Was More Successful?
texto: Backstreet Boys vs. NSYNC: Which Boy Band Was More Successful? In the late 1990s and early 2000s, Backstreet Boys and NSYNC were two of the biggest boy bands in the world. Backstreet Boys sold more than 100 million records worldwide. NSYNC sold about 70 million records worldwide. Therefore, Backstreet Boys were more successful than NSYNC in total record sales. However, NSYNC released one of the fastest-selling albums in music history. Their album No Strings Attached sold about 2.4 million copies in its first week in the United States. That was more than any other album at the time. Backstreet Boys had more international success than NSYNC. Their music was popular in Europe, Asia, and Latin America. They also completed larger world tours and performed in more countries. When it comes to awards, both groups were very successful. Backstreet Boys received more than 200 awards, while NSYNC won over 150 awards. Backstreet Boys were more recognized internationally, but NSYNC was often more popular among teenagers in the United States. Another important difference is the members' careers after the groups slowed down. Justin Timberlake became the most successful solo artist from either band. He won multiple Grammy Awards and sold millions of albums as a solo singer. Today, Backstreet Boys are still performing together more than 30 years after they were formed. They are one of the longest-lasting boy bands in pop music history. Many fans think they have the strongest vocal harmonies, while others believe NSYNC had the most exciting dance performances. In the end, Backstreet Boys were more successful in total sales, but NSYNC had one of the biggest albums ever released. Both groups remain among the most famous boy bands of all time. texto: Erling Haaland and Carrots Erling Haaland is a famous football player from Norway. He likes to eat carrots as a snack. Many people see videos of him eating carrots. In 2026, more people in Norway started buying carrots. Some farmers said this happened because of Haaland. They called it the “Haaland Effect.” Many children like Haaland. Some children started eating carrots instead of candy. A few children even called carrots “Haaland candy.” Haaland was also in a vegetable advertisement during the World Cup. This helped more people see him eating healthy food. Today, carrots are very popular in Norway. Many people think Haaland helped make them more popular.
